title: Better Enchanting compat - Galosphere
description: Datapack adding compatibility between mods Better Enchanting and Galosphere
body:
This datapack adds compatibility between Better Enchanting and Galosphere mods. You will also need to add enchantments to "config\better-enchanting\enchantment_ingredients.json". Here is an example:

  "galosphere:enfeeble": [
    "galosphere:cured_membrane"
  ],
  "galosphere:rupture": [
    "galosphere:silver_ingot",
    "galosphere:salted_jerky",
    "minecraft:clock"
  ],
  "galosphere:sustain": [
    "galosphere:silver_ingot",
    "galosphere:salted_jerky",
    "minecraft:clock"
  ]

  You can change the ingredients to your liking.
